rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides identity verification, bidirectional trust scoring, and transaction authorization for autonomous AI agents. Implements a four-tier Know Your Agent (KYA) identity system, real-time counterparty reputation scoring across three risk zones, and a non-custodial authorization engine that returns signed attestations. Supports agent registration, identity verification, trust checks, and transaction authorization through both REST API and MCP endpoints.
